$description: Legacy-derived keys (piano) pattern bank manifest. Maps canonical Casperaki genres → which keys style(s) to draw piano patterns from (legacy config.json#defaultStyleMappings.pianoPatterns). Each style declares a `kind`: 'chordPattern' (file-backed; format 'hitGroups' = chordsStraight hit-group pools, format 'absHitTriples' = edmHousePiano [absHit,duration,layer] triples) emitting `chord` events; 'algo' (chordsMixed / arpeggio) handled by keys-algo.ts; 'ezKeys' (library / altLibrary) handled by piano-bank.ts emitting `noteRelative` events. The generator picks one style for the genre via ctx.rng.fork('patterns/keys') (legacy Tools.selectRandomly). chordsStraight / chordsMixed / arpeggio are legacy `freestyle`-only styles — shipped as available styles + unit-tested but not mapped to any canonical genre by default.
